query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(t)),'[]') FROM (SELECT window_start,count(*) AS receipts,count(DISTINCT scope_id) AS scopes,count(DISTINCT (source_id,scope_id,kind,window_start)) AS distinct_keys FROM app.observation_receipt WHERE window_start >= '2026-10-09T16:08:00Z' AND window_start < '2026-10-09T16:11:00Z' GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY window_start) t
